newsitem.title: LATVIA: GDP GROWTH SEEN AT 4-5PCT YEAR UNTIL 2002.
newsitem.headline: GDP GROWTH SEEN AT 4-5PCT YEAR UNTIL 2002.

text.p: Latvia's gross domestic product (GDP) is expected to grow at an average rate of 4-5 percent until the year 2002, the Finance Ministry said on Friday.
"We are looking forward to a stable development with four to five percent GDP growth on average until 2002," Inna Steinbruka, deputy head of the finance ministry's planning department said.
Latvian GDP in 1996 was 3.6 percent, according to preliminary data.
